project_name.justification: The article is titled: "Clarity Gold Enters Option to Acquire a 50% Interest in the Lithium381 Property".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Clarity Gold Corp. (“Clarity” or the “Company”) (CSE: CLAR, OTC: CLGCF, FSE: 27G)". The name Clarity Metals Corp. is used as per the authoritative metadata.

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is signed off by "“James Rogers” Chief Executive Officer".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company has entered into an option agreement "to earn an undivided 50% right, title, ownership and beneficial interest in and to 21 mineral claims...".

primary_commodity.justification: The press release states: "This Option Agreement marks Clarity’s step towards diversifying its mineral portfolio into the exciting lithium space".

verified_article_link.justification: The provided text is a press release and does not contain a URL to the original article.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Clarity Gold Corp., is based in Vancouver, British Columbia, and is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), implying the use of Canadian Dollars (CAD) for the '$' symbol.

cash_payments_raw.justification: No direct cash payments for the property are mentioned. A $25,000 deposit is mentioned, but it is explicitly included as part of the exploration commitment: "incur an aggregate of $750,000 in exploration expenditures on or before December 31, 2024, inclusive of the deposit of $25,000 provided by the Company to the Optionor...".

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction consideration is structured as an issuance of a number of shares and an exploration commitment, which is captured under `amount_of_shares_issued` and `exploration_commitment_value_raw`.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration components (shares and exploration commitment) are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: Under the Option Agreement, Clarity must "issue an aggregate of 720,000 common shares of the Company (the “Shares”)...".

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The warrants mentioned in the text are part of a separate non-brokered private placement for general corporate purposes, not as consideration for the property acquisition.

option_payments_raw.justification: The stock options mentioned are part of an "Equity Compensation Grant" to employees, directors, and officers, not as consideration for the property acquisition.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the issuance of 720,000 shares but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.025'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The agreement includes a monetary exploration commitment, not a commitment for a specific number of meters to be drilled.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: To maintain the option, the Company must "incur an aggregate of $750,000 in exploration expenditures on or before December 31, 2024...".

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: There is no mention of a Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or any other royalty being acquired or retained as part of the transaction terms.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The property consists of "21 mineral claims covering approximately 1107 hectares (the “Property”)".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The size of the property is described as a "1107 ha land position".

resource_size.justification: The text explicitly states the property has not been explored for the target commodity: "The Property has not previously been explored for lithium bearing pegmatites". The resource mentioned in the text (40.3 Mt) belongs to the adjacent Allkem Limited's James Bay Lithium project.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer, Clarity Gold Corp., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE) as stated: '(CSE: CLAR...)'. The ticker 'CMET' is used based on the authoritative metadata provided.
